name: 🚗 租车行
desc: 驾照核验·满油归还·保险费率·还车地点·加驾司机·延误费·车型升级·油费·导航租借·车况检查

items.en: Please show your driver's license.
items.zh: 请出示您的驾照。

items.en: The car must be returned full.
items.zh: 还车时油箱必须加满。

items.en: Insurance is included in the rate.
items.zh: 保险已含在租金里。

items.en: Please check the car for damage.
items.zh: 请检查车辆是否有损伤。

items.en: A navigation device costs extra.
items.zh: 导航设备需另收费。

items.en: We offer compact and full-size cars.
items.zh: 我们提供紧凑型和全尺寸车。

items.en: Sign here to confirm the pickup.
items.zh: 请在此签字确认取车。

items.en: Please return the vehicle to this lot by noon.
items.zh: 请在中午前把车还到这个停车场。

items.en: A second driver can be added for a small fee.
items.zh: 加一名司机只需付一笔小费用。

items.en: Insurance is included in the daily rate automatically.
items.zh: 保险自动含在每日租金中。

items.en: The fuel tank should be full at return.
items.zh: 还车时油箱应当是满的。

items.en: You can pick up your car after ten o'clock.
items.zh: 十点以后您就能取车了。
chunks: You can pick up your car

items.en: Please report any scratches to the front desk immediately.
items.zh: 有任何划痕请立即向前台报告。

items.en: The daily rate covers unlimited miles within the state.
items.zh: 每日租金包含州内不限里程。

items.en: If you return the car after noon, an extra day will be charged to your card.
items.zh: 如果您中午之后才还车，会向您的卡多收一天的费用。

items.en: Customers who booked a compact car may be upgraded when none are left.
items.zh: 预订了紧凑型车的顾客，若没车了可能会被升级。
chunks: Customers who booked a compact car
skeleton: 预订了紧凑型车的顾客

items.en: If the tank is not full, we will charge you for the fuel.
items.zh: 如果油箱没加满，我们会向您收取油费。

items.en: Drivers who are under twenty-five must pay a young-driver surcharge at the front desk.
items.zh: 二十五岁以下的司机必须在前台支付一笔年轻司机附加费。
skeleton: 必须支付年轻司机附加费

items.en: Because the lot is closed at night, please use the after-hours drop box.
items.zh: 由于停车场夜间关闭，请使用非营业时间还车箱。

items.en: When you pick up the car, please inspect the tires and the mirrors carefully.
items.zh: 取车时，请仔细检查轮胎和后视镜。

items.en: The insurance plan that we offer will cover most repairs after an accident.
items.zh: 我们提供的保险方案能覆盖事故后的大部分维修。
